description: Compatibility endpoint with an x_user_stream-shaped envelope: stops watching an account. Irreversible. Cost: Free per call. Docs: https://docs.twitterapis.com/docs/reference/monitoring/oapi-x-user-stream-remove-user-to-monitor-tweet

id_for_user.description: The monitor id, as listed by the x_user_stream list endpoint; the same value as the monitor id elsewhere in the monitoring API.

name: twitter_x_user_stream_remove_user
title: Stop Watching Account (Stream Format)
